title: llluminate Your Heart!
body:
Allah is the only Sultan. He never likes things which are artificial or official. Governments may be official, but
religions cannot. But nowadays Christianity is an official religion. Islam is an official religion. Judaism is
official. The other religions we do not accept as being religions. We only accept the ones which belong to
Heavens, and after Islam no new religion does.
Religions have to be above anything official. The official people must be under the command of religion, not
the other way around. Anything official will destroy the sincerity. Official imams, official priests and official
rabbis cannot give anything. Do you think that plastic grapes or oranges will give you any taste? That is the
main problem and it is waiting for a solution.
Religious decisions and authority cannot be left in the hands of people who come here to the university to
make their doctor degrees. These people are too big to even be able to enter the doors of synagogues,
churches or mosques. They have got so many official artificial hormones that they can hardly move because
they need such big places. They are growing in such an ugly way: they are getting fat, their backs are looking
very strange, their heads are getting smaller, their stomach bigger. Their mind is getting smaller, they cannot
think about anything but themselves.

People are running from here to there asking their Lord for something. They must realise that they cannot
take any benefit from someone who is official. Anything official kills the sincerity. When people lose the
sincere people within religions, they will start running after the official ones who cannot make them content
and reach peace.
A hundred years ago these same words were spoken and people started crying. That is how affected they
were. Nowadays people escape. They do not want to hear it. In the 19th century words from religious people
still had an impact.
What happened? People of the 19th century were still sincere. When something comes from the heart it will
go to the heart. If it comes from your lips it will go nowhere. It is our sincere belief that when we ask
sincerely, He will send. But people now are accustomed to plastic flowers in their homes which is why the
gardener doesn't bother to plant any roses or any other flowers. People only want appearances. If you try to
smell them, it is like thorns touching your nose.
For millions and billions of years angels have been glorifying their Lord. He created everything for
Muhammad*. He created mankind for him. He ordered the angels to be residents of Heavens and to give
their glory to him. Adam was created for him and was given his divine lights. All this because Muhammad* is
the first and the last creation in the Divine Presence to be mentioned as His servant and His prophet. He is
the main treasure. Every creature takes his grant from what he was given.
Oh people, servants of the Lord of Heavens! He has endless armies of every kind. Our humble glory be to
Him. Everyone is glorifying the Lord. He is the only One Who is glorified. He has endless, countless glory
oceans. Whatever you try to give Him, even if every creature on earth and in Heavens would gather, it would
only be like a needle in an endless ocean, compared to His endless ocean. Mankind has been honoured in
such a great way. They must give their obedience to their Lord and they must do it through him,
Muhammad*, who has been glorified. He is the most Glorified One.
That is real contentment which can take away every kind of sadness from our heart. It illuminates our hearts
in a way that darkness cannot enter. The disease of the century is that the hearts of people are depressed. It is
a result of darkness within the hearts of people. When the light is extinguished in the heart, it will be dark
and people will be hopeless, full of fear and depressed.

Only glorifying your Lord can take the darkness away from your heart. It will dress you with lights in your
heart. If you do not feel like it in your home, then run to the countryside or to deserts or jungles, to silent
places. Glorify Him and you will see that the depression will leave you quickly. It will run away from you and
ask for help to be saved from you! That is the cure for depression. You may be a Christian, a Jew or a Muslim,
you can glorify with any of the Holy Words which are in the Holy Books. You will find a cure quickly and will
enjoy being alive. Sadness will escape. Nothing can disturb you. You will be protected by the lights of
glorification.
Oh people, don't waste your precious time with useless actions. Try to have something which will give you
honour, glory, satisfaction and contentment here and hereafter. That is if you like! If you don't care, every
curse will run on you, you will suffer. Protect your heart by glorifying. If you do not take care of that, so many
devils will run to you and disturb you. Everyone of them speaks in another way and will put a new sword
through your heart. They will disturb you in every way and only escape by you glorifying. Don't forget!
If anyone would hear the beautiful sounds of the angels who are glorifying the Lord in the Seven Heavens,
they would fall down dead. That is how beautiful it is. May Allah let us hear. When Mehdi comes our ears will
be clean. Now we have too much dirt locking our ears from hearing the sounds of the angels glorifying the
Lord in Heaven. Try to clean them from early morning until late at night. But instead people put more and
more dirt into their ears by listening to modern music making them unable to hear. At the time of dawn some
people can have the chance in the Night of Power to hear just one second of that Divine sound. It is a good advice
for everyone to pray every morning before Fajr, "Subhana Rabbi-l wal hamdi, subhan alathi wa'staghir'ullah..."

When you start doing such a glorification sincerely, you will not want to stop. Do this 100 times between sunna and fard
prayers in the morning.

It will give you support. Your soul will be happy and light. If any wants the Doors of

Paradise to be opened for them, they should say, "Al hamdulillah". If they want the doors of hell to be closed
for them, they may say, "Astarhfir'ullah".
01.01.1996
